full_judgment: 54. It is pertinent to note that once Revision of Record of Rights was finally published under section 144(7) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act (SAT Act) and the publication shall be conclusive evidence that the record has been duly prepared or revised under this section. Section 144A lays down that a finally published record of rights prepared or revised under section 144 of the state Acquisition and Tenancy Act has a presumption of correctness and that presumption continues till it is otherwise rebutted by reliable evidence. In the present case it is evident from Annexure-G (1) to the Affidavit-in-Reply that the names of the petitioner's predecessors were finally published in the RS Khatian No. 76, Plot NICS. 1617/1618/1619/ 1620/1621/1670/ 1671 of Mouza-Tejgaon Shilpa Elaka. In such view of the matter, continuation of Miscellaneous Case No. 19 of 1987 and decisions passed by the Revenue Officers and the Land Appeal Board become inoperative since RS Khatian No. 76 has finally been published in respect of the case property in the name of the predecessors of the petitioners during continuation of Miscellaneous Case No. 19 of 1987.
